def problem_spec
-- function signature
(impl: List Rat → Int)
-- inputs
(lst: List Rat) :=
-- spec
let spec (result: Int) :=
  (lst = [] → result = 0) ∧
  (lst != [] → 0 ≤ result - lst[0]!.ceil^2 ∧ (impl (lst.drop 1) = (result - lst[0]!.ceil^2)))
-- program termination
